mapper.select: select p.product_id, p.product_title, p.product_name, p.product_content, MIN(PO.OPTION_PRICE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY PO.OPTION_ID ASC) AS PRICE from product p join optiondetail o on p.product_id = o.product_id join productoption po on po.option_id = o.option_id where p.product_id = #{productId} and p.status = 'ON_SALE' GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_title, p.product_name, p.product_content
select product_image_save_name as thumbnail from productimage where product_id = #{productId} and product_title_image = 0
select product_image_save_name as images from productimage where product_id = #{productId} and product_title_image = 1

select o.option_id, o.option_name, o.option_price as price from productoption o join optiondetail od on o.option_id = od.option_id join product p on od.product_id = p.product_id where p.product_id = #{productId}
